snippet.title: SHOCK – Demo Announcement
snippet.description:
What Do You See? –  SHOCK Demo Announcement
A glimpse into the nightmare.

Enter the world of SHOCK, a third-person survival horror experience where you play as a disabled war veteran stalked by a relentless cybernetic creature. This cinematic teaser sets the tone for the horrors to come.

💥 The free demo is available now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3617980/Shock_Demo/

WISHLIST SHOCK here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3391130/SHOCK/


#SHOCK #HorrorGame #IndieGame #SurvivalHorror #DemoTeaser
